description: This source file is a Swift extension for the ProcessInfo class, providing utility methods to determine runtime environments such as preview mode, nix mode, and test runs. It includes methods for interpreting environment variables, user defaults, and bundle information.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: An extension of the built-in ProcessInfo class that adds computed properties and static methods to determine the current runtime environment status, such as preview mode, nix mode, and test execution.

methods.name: isPreview
methods.description: Returns true if the environment indicates running inside Xcode previews, based on the 'XCODE_RUNNING_FOR_PREVIEWS' environment variable.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: Determines whether the application is running in nix mode based on environment variables, user defaults, and whether it is an app bundle.

methods.name: isNixMode
methods.description: Computed property that detects if the app is running in nix mode using environment info, user defaults, and bundle info.

methods.name: isRunningTests
methods.description: Detects if the application is currently executing test code by examining loaded bundles and environment variables related to testing.
